excerpt.zh: 远离[Planet.GetName]人口中心的活跃火山山脉中，一座古庙破败残存。了解其历史或能更深入了解当地文化。
excerpt.en: Far from the population centers of [Planet.GetName], in a range of active volcanic mountains, an ancient temple lies in ruins and disrepair. Understanding its history may grant us further insights into the planet's local culture.

texts.zh: 远离[Planet.GetName]人口中心的活跃火山山脉中，一座古庙破败残存。了解其历史或能更深入了解当地文化。
texts.en: Far from the population centers of [Planet.GetName], in a range of active volcanic mountains, an ancient temple lies in ruins and disrepair. Understanding its history may grant us further insights into the planet's local culture.

sections.zh: 远离[Planet.GetName]人口中心的活跃火山山脉中，一座古庙破败残存。了解其历史或能更深入了解当地文化。
sections.en: Far from the population centers of [Planet.GetName], in a range of active volcanic mountains, an ancient temple lies in ruins and disrepair. Understanding its history may grant us further insights into the planet's local culture.

texts.zh:
神庙上存有战斗痕迹，土壤中残存当地智慧生命遗骸。神庙似被焚毁后遗弃。安保团队注意到当地居民完全避开此地，视之为诅咒。

在外墙保护下，火焰神庙内部得以保存。里面留有大量精致的壁画和雕刻，其中多次出现一圈卷曲的火焰图案，火焰中央则是一道漆黑裂隙。在一幅壁画中，一个双足生物从自己的四只眼睛中挖出一只抛向大地，形成火焰中央的图案，我们将其命名为“地狱之眼”。

后续发掘将揭示此异象相关信仰。
texts.en:
The temple itself is scarred by signs of battle, and there are ancient remains of the local sentient species in the soil. It seems the temple was torched and abandoned. Security teams have noted that the locals avoid this entire area, believing it to be cursed. 

The fire temple's walls protected its contents, including many intricate frescos and carvings. These feature a recurring motif of a circle of twisted fire, with a dark gash down its center. In one depiction, a bipedal figure plucks out one of four such eyes and casts it upon the world, creating this central motif. We are designating it the Infernal Eye. 

Further excavations will reveal what beliefs surrounded this strange figure.

texts.zh:
对地狱之眼神庙的发掘显示大量祭献痕迹。神庙内有多处大型圆坑，圆坑中央设有平台，模仿地狱之眼及瞳孔。坑内积满灰烬与炭块，分子分析表明这些来自动物组织。

尚不明确祭品为野生或家养动物，还是当地居民。

特工已前往当前人口中心寻找相关证据，挖掘队继续探寻答案。
texts.en:
Excavations of the temple of the Infernal Eye show evidence of many sacrifices. Large circular pits with platforms in the center, mimicking the Infernal Eye and its pupil, lie filled with layers of ash and charcoal. Molecular analysis reveals that the ash and charcoal comes from animal tissue. 

Whether these sacrifices were of wild or domestic animals, or indeed of the locals themselves, cannot be determined. 

Agents have been dispatched to current population centers in search of corollary evidence, while our excavators search for more answers.

label.en: It's a mystery waiting to be solved!
Send drones to solve that mystery.

texts.zh:
一扇沉重的石门挡住了进入神庙最深处的路。破门后，挖掘队发现一个圆形房间，房间中央的坑洞直通地下的天然岩浆池。岩浆发出橙色光芒映红墙壁，隐约映照出环绕整个奇怪房间的铭文。墙壁顶端一周布满明亮炽热的眼睛。

坑边祭坛形似地狱之眼，上面散落着一具干枯的当地居民遗骸，疑为祭献安抚地狱之眼所用。

墙壁上的铭文对理解神庙的文化职能至关重要，应立即破译。
texts.en:
A heavy stone doorway was discovered blocking off the deepest part of the temple. After breaking through, excavators found a circular chamber with a central pit opening directly above a natural underground magma reservoir. The orange light of the magma bathed the walls in a red glow, faintly illuminating inscriptions encircling the strange room. The top of the surrounding walls are studded with bright, flaming eyes.

On one edge of this pit are the desiccated remains of one of the locals, broken open upon an altar shaped like the Infernal Eye. It appears they were in fact sacrificing their own in an attempt to appease it.

The text along these walls may be critical to understanding the cultural role of this temple, and should be translated immediately.

texts.zh:
最终研究发现，神庙最深处房间中的经文揭示了一系列围绕地狱之眼回归的预言，讲述地狱之眼因臣民蔑视燃起怒火，将使天空变暗、圣山喷发、特定作物枯萎，灾祸连绵不断。预言预示文明终结，唯有服从地狱之眼者得以幸存。

本地特工探寻其中的文化关联，发现此预言是该行星文化中许多谚语和神话的源头，而当地现代神庙所举行的神秘仪式则是对此古老预言的重新演绎或反抗。

我方技术可以重现预言中的事件，或通过伪造，以假乱真。倘若我们自诩地狱之眼转世，印证预言不虚，便能迫使对方让步并效忠于我们，为长期同化创造条件。
texts.en:
The final study of the scripture in the temple's innermost chamber reveals a set of prophecies relating to the return of the Infernal Eye. It speaks of the Infernal Eye growing angry at the defiance of its subjects. In response, the Eye is expected to darken the skies, erupt a specific holy mountain, cause a specific crop to wither on the vine, and more. The prophecy presents this as the end of civilization, stating that after these events, only those who submit to the Infernal Eye shall survive. 

Our agents among the local populace have looked for cultural connections, and found that this prophetic text is the source of many aphorisms and phrases in the planet's cultures, as well as the source text for many later stories and myths. They also believe that the mysteries practiced by their modern temples include variations on, and reactions against, this ancient prophecy. 

All of these prophesied events could be re-enacted with our technology, or faked with a degree of realism they will not be able to detect. If we were to present ourselves as the Infernal Eye reincarnate, demonstrating that the original prophecy was right all along, we may be able to extract concessions and fealty from them. This would make them easier to absorb in the long term.

label.zh: 他们的历史已永远湮灭。
label.en: Their history has been lost forever.
